body:
- cuda: stage the lightning indexer queries in head passes for MUSA

MUSA archs 21 and 22 cap static shared memory at 28 KB, and the tile

kernel staged the queries of all four heads next to the key tile for

33 KB. The queries are now staged in passes of

LIGHTNING_INDEXER_TILE_HEADS_PER_PASS heads: two on MUSA for 25 KB,

four elsewhere where the single pass folds to the previous kernel.

- cuda: use the vector lightning indexer kernel on MUSA

Address review from am17an: the tile kernel stays off MUSA, whose archs

21 and 22 cap static shared memory at 28 KB, below the 33 KB the tile

needs, so MUSA keeps the vector kernel it ran before. This replaces the

head passes, CUDA and ROCm run the merged kernel unchanged.
summaryZh: llama.cpp 发布了 b11422 版本更新，针对 MUSA 架构静态共享内存限制进行了优化。由于 MUSA 架构 21 和 22 对共享内存有限制，该更新将 Lightning 索引器查询在头部遍历中进行分段处理（passes），并在 MUSA 上使用专门的向量化内核替代 tile 内核，从而确保兼容性与运行效率。
